data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password** as the best all-round password manager.

It's particularly good for teams that need to share passwords securely, manage employee access, and avoid the chaos of shared spreadsheets or passwords in Slack.

There are three providers I'd seriously consider: 1Password, Bitwarden and Dashlane.

## Best options compared

![Get to know 1Password for Mac | 1Password Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/C4U7UvvWr1lsit0fdwRMADZs7wYIji_AIA_d_hCeSHTTS1dPoJwwNeSzAPqWszRkpvDsM-p6I-6bznHJsD41eDQWYBj0MySy4qOfvgyzlD_4z3rPSGN9LVxo1hBQTb8qLml3yarSFkZEwcSqyJe7UAnBKtGHsXMSYuWNAwGS3UO1kE8Ogcbnaa14C9ioehoa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Strong admin controls and security alerts.
- Great for non-technical staff.

Teams Starter Pack: US\$24.95/month for up to 10 users, billed annually.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source core.
- Strong team sharing and collections.
- Audit logs and directory synchronisation.
- Good choice for technically minded teams.

Teams: US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Good administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Useful for organisations with more formal security requirements.

Business Starter pricing reported from US\$2/user/month.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

Pricing is in USD, before tax, and may vary with billing terms. Sources: [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cybercred.com.au](https://cybercred.com.au/articles/password-managers-compared-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to\:

- **1Password** if you want something polished that employees will actually enjoy using.
- **Bitwarden** if you want excellent security and functionality while keeping costs down.

For either option, make sure you configure\:

- Individual employee accounts.
- Shared team vaults.
- Two-factor authentication.
- Admin-controlled access and offboarding.
- Separate vaults for finance, IT, marketing and general operations.

## One question to help me choose the right one

How big is your team?

**1\. Number of people**
